An anchor wrapping a table renders the table as a block instead of an escaped link label

```c title="C"
#include <assert.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include "html_to_markdown.h"

int main(void) {
    HTMAlefHandle result = htm_convert("<a href=\"https://example.com/outer\"><table><tr><td><a href=\"https://example.com/inner\">Inner</a></td></tr></table></a>", 0);
    htm_conversion_result_free(result);
    return EXIT_SUCCESS;
}
```
